EN: I sent everyone on hand to investigate. But I am the only Knight here, so...
ZH: 我把手头所有人都派下去查了。但我是这里唯一的骑士，所以……

EN: No one came back.
ZH: 没人回来。

EN: This must be the supply room the Knight mentioned.
ZH: 这肯定是那位骑士提到的补给室了。

EN: Let's see how much we can carry!
ZH: 看看我们能搬走多少！

EN: Protect the infiltration team.
ZH: 保护渗透小队。

EN: Synths. The Knight was right!
ZH: 合成人。骑士说对了！

EN: Reinforcements? Wait, you're not Brotherhood.
ZH: 援军？等等，你们不是兄弟会的。

EN: Sharp one.
ZH: 真机灵。

EN: More fodder, then.
ZH: 那就只是更多的炮灰罢了。

EN: Here to meddle in the Institute's affairs one last time.
ZH: 这是你们最后一次干涉学院的事了。

EN: Neither are you.
ZH: 你们也不是。

EN: Your Knight sent us.
ZH: 你们的骑士派我们来的。

EN: We're Vault Dwellers.
ZH: 我们是避难所居民。

EN: Our extraction is unsuccessful, the enemy is here.
ZH: 我们撤离失败，敌人来了。

EN: Saboteurs! Must've come through from the same holes the Mole rats came from…
ZH: 破坏者！准是从鼹鼠进来的那些洞钻进来的……

EN: This is the generator room. Can we fix it?
ZH: 这是发电机室。我们能修好吗？

EN: <Tinkering with the engine>
ZH: <摆弄发动机>

EN: Hmm, I see. They were thorough.
ZH: 嗯，我明白了。他们破坏得非常彻底。

EN: We can restart the generator, but the array will never work again.
ZH: 我们能重启发电机，但阵列再也无法运作了。

EN: At least the Brotherhood get to keep their base.
ZH: 至少兄弟会能保住基地。

EN: And like any good engineering job, we get to keep the leftover bits.
ZH: 而且跟任何一项好的工程活一样，剩下的零件归我们。

EN: Eradication incomplete. Further correction required.
ZH: 清除不彻底。需要进一步修正。

EN: Additional hostiles detected. Total termination authorized.
ZH: 检测到更多敌对者。授权全面清除。

EN: Things are getting worse for the Railroad. Relentless Institute attacks have cornered them in a building on the outskirts of Boston. They need help.
ZH: 铁路的日子越来越难过了。学院的穷追不舍，把他们逼到波士顿郊区一栋建筑里。他们需要帮助。

EN: Runaway Train
ZH: 失控的火车

EN: Find survivors
ZH: 寻找幸存者

EN: The Railroad has been cornered by the Institute. We have to help them.
ZH: 铁路被学院逼入绝境。我们必须去帮他们。

EN: You are too late, Vault Dweller. Your friend Wyatt is dead. The Railroad is finished.
ZH: 你来得太迟了，避难所居民。你的朋友怀亚特已经死了。铁路彻底完蛋了。

EN: The Railroad is an idea. Ideas don't die. You, on the other hand...
ZH: 铁路是一种理念。理念不会死。而你，则是另一回事……

EN: There is a symbol drawn behind that painting. A hidden cache is nearby.
ZH: 那幅画后面画着一个符号。附近有处藏匿点。

EN: Let's loot it.
ZH: 搜刮一下吧。

EN: Ah! It's you! Poetic, isn't it? You and Wyatt, erased on the same day.
ZH: 啊！是你！多讽刺，对吧？你和怀亚特，同一天被抹去。

EN: That's X2-SQUARE? Care to try again?
ZH: 是X2-Square才对。要不要再试试？

EN: Didn't we kill you already? What was it? “X2-foureyes?”
ZH: 我们不是干掉过你吗？叫啥来着？“X2四眼”？

EN: We cleared the area, and there's no sign of Wyatt.
ZH: 我们清空了这片区域，没有怀亚特的踪迹。

EN: And here we are at a dead end... or is it? What does this terminal do?
ZH: 我们走到了死胡同……等等，真的是吗？这台终端机是干什么的？

EN: <Enter Friendship Code>
ZH: <输入友谊代码>

EN: A “Friendship Code”? Could the code Wyatt gave us work here?
ZH: 一个“友谊代码”？怀亚特给我们的代码能在这儿用吗？

EN: Bingo. A hidden door.
ZH: 成了。一扇暗门。

EN: Are you the Vault Dweller Wyatt spoke so highly of?
ZH: 你就是怀亚特赞不绝口的那个避难所居民？

EN: That's what Wyatt would want. May I come with you while I plan my next move?
ZH: 那是怀亚特的心愿。我在计划下一步的时候，能跟你们一起走吗？

EN: Wyatt said I had a will of steel, but I'm no leader. Maybe you know one? Until then, can I hide with you?
ZH: 怀亚特说我意志如钢，但我不是当领袖的料。也许你知道谁行？在那之前，我能跟你们躲一阵吗？

EN: If you believe in the Railroad, you can keep the dream alive.
ZH: 只要你相信铁路，就能让这个梦想延续下去。

EN: Rebuild the movement. More secretive. More ruthless.
ZH: 重建这个运动。更隐蔽。更冷酷。

EN: Wyatt... Poor Wyatt... They turned him into goo.
ZH: 怀亚特……可怜的怀亚特……他们把他化成了一滩浆糊。

EN: It's all over. Our dream. I'm all that's left.
ZH: 一切都结束了。我们的梦想。就剩我了。

EN: What am I supposed to do?
ZH: 我该怎么办？

EN: Railroaded
ZH: 被迫上路

EN: You think these things are part of the Brotherhood?
ZH: 你们觉得这些东西是兄弟会的？

EN: An Elder from the Brotherhood of Steel has proposed a meeting to discuss battle plans against the Institute. Let's see what they've got to offer.
ZH: 钢铁兄弟会的一位长老提出要会面，商讨对抗学院的作战计划。看看他们能提供什么。

EN: A Steel Fist in a Velvet Glove
ZH: 丝绒手套里的铁拳

EN: Meet with the Brotherhood Elder
ZH: 与兄弟会长老会面

EN: Attend a war meeting with the Brotherhood of Steel.
ZH: 出席与钢铁兄弟会的作战会议。

EN: Ah, Vault folk. Hello! I'm Squire Daniels.
ZH: 啊，避难所的朋友。你们好！我是侍从丹尼尔斯。

EN: Well, we have to be sure there are no Synth spies. You understand.
ZH: 呃，我们得确保没有合成人间谍。你明白的。

EN: No, no, I need to stay here. To stop anyone that might come in to disrupt our talks.
ZH: 不不，我得留在这儿，拦住任何可能进来搅局的人。

EN: Why are we meeting in this cave?
ZH: 我们为什么在这洞里开会？

EN: Are you coming with me?
ZH: 你跟我一起来吗？

EN: The Elder wants to meet with you. He's underground a ways.
ZH: 长老想见你。往地下再走一段就是。

EN: Hope you don't get lost!
ZH: 希望你们别迷路！

EN: Aaah! I can't take it anymore!
ZH: 啊！我再也受不了了！

EN: Right. You keep going, then. I'm outta here.
ZH: 行吧。那你继续吧。我撤了。

EN: Sure. They were in our way to get to your boss.
ZH: 当然。它们挡了我们见你老大的路。

EN: The scorpions… they're everywhere! I barely escaped!
ZH: 那些蝎子……到处都是！我差点没逃出来！

EN: Wait, you… you beat up the Scorpions?
ZH: 等等，你们……你们把那些蝎子都干趴下了？

EN: Hey, I remember you. You're the maybe-Synths from that Ghoul-infested building.
ZH: 嘿，我记得你们。你们就是从那座满是尸鬼的大楼里出来的那伙“疑似合成人”吧。

EN: Oh, plenty. Not that I'd share with you…
ZH: 哦，多着呢。不过我可不会分给你……

EN: Mostly Radroach steak. Want a taste? I might believe you're not a Synth if you eat it.
ZH: 大多是辐射蟑螂排。想来一口吗？你吃掉它，我或许就信你不是合成人。

EN: Find anything interesting?
ZH: 找到什么有趣的东西了吗？

EN: What do you eat around here?
ZH: 你们在这儿吃什么？

EN: I've found a new family. These Radscorpions are DEFINITELY not Synths.
ZH: 我找到了新家人。这些辐射蝎绝对不可能是合成人。

EN: I had started thinking, maybe the Institute have replica Ghouls now, prowling the Wasteland…
ZH: 我开始琢磨，学院现在是不是造出了尸鬼复制品，在废土上游荡……

EN: So I came here. And for some reason, the Brotherhood is here too. And you.
ZH: 所以我来了这儿。而不知为何，兄弟会也在这儿。还有你们。

EN: Never any peace and quiet…
ZH: 从来就没个清静……

EN: Hsssskkk!
ZH: 嘶嘶嘶！

EN: Rrrsssshaaaak!
ZH: 嘶嘶嘶啊！

EN: Rrrsssshaaaak!
ZH: 嘶嘶嘶啊！

EN: Shhhhhkrrrsk…
ZH: 嘶……嘶嘶咔……

EN: Hey, uh, are you the Brotherhood Elder?
ZH: 嘿，呃，你就是兄弟会长老吗？

EN: I'm starting to think we may have been tricked.
ZH: 我开始觉得我们可能被骗了。

EN: Down, girl. Stay. Good girl.
ZH: 趴下，姑娘。待着。好姑娘。

EN: You! I can barely believe you're still alive.
ZH: 你们！真不敢相信你们还活着。

EN: Let's see about that. Troops: open fire!
ZH: 那我们来试试看。士兵们：开火！

EN: That's what I thought. Troops: open fire!
ZH: 果然如此。士兵们：开火！

EN: What do you know of honor? You cower in your vault while we fight to survive. Troops: open fire!
ZH: 你懂什么叫荣誉吗？我们在外面拼死求生，你们却缩在避难所里。士兵们：开火！

EN: Weak? If anything, we're stronger from the experience.
ZH: 虚弱？要说的话，这次经历让我们更强了。

EN: Oh, yes, I can barely hold my weapon.
ZH: 哦，是啊，我连武器都举不稳。

EN: I thought the Brotherhood was supposed to be honorable.
ZH: 我还以为兄弟会是有荣誉感的。

EN: The other Elders and I decided you couldn't be trusted.
ZH: 我和其他长老一致认为，你们不可信。

EN: Vault-Tec was an evil organization, who profited from the Great War.
ZH: 避难所科技是个邪恶的组织，靠大战发了财。

EN: And now that you're helping Synths and the Railroads, you're our enemy as much as the Institute.
ZH: 如今你们帮助合成人和铁路，你们就是我们的敌人，和学院一样。

EN: You must be strong… but surely weak from fighting.
ZH: 你们一定很强……但想必已被战斗耗得虚弱。

EN: Protect our Fusion Cores at all costs!
ZH: 不惜一切代价保护我们的聚变核心！

EN: We're under attack!
ZH: 我们遭到攻击！

EN: Our betrayal is coming back to haunt us!
ZH: 我们的背叛终于来报复我们了！

EN: The Brotherhood made the mistake of becoming our enemies, so let's raid their storage and steal their Fusion Cores!
ZH: 兄弟会犯了个错误，成了我们的敌人。那我们去劫掠他们的仓库，偷走他们的聚变核心！

EN: The Power Room
ZH: 能源室

EN: Steal some Fusion Cores
ZH: 偷走一些聚变核心

EN: Mess with the Brotherhood's network
ZH: 破坏兄弟会的网络

EN: Steal Fusion Cores from the Brotherhood now that we're enemies.
ZH: 既然我们和兄弟会成了敌人，去偷他们的聚变核心。

EN: Okay, we made it. Let's go over the plan.
ZH: 好，我们到了。来对一下计划。

EN: We go in, we find some Fusion Cores, we leave.
ZH: 我们进去，找到聚变核心，然后撤退。

EN: … And beat up anyone from the Brotherhood who tries to stop us.
ZH: ……顺便揍扁任何敢拦我们的兄弟会成员。

EN: And they'll deserve it, because they betrayed our alliance!
ZH: 他们活该，因为他们背叛了我们的同盟！

EN: All agreed? Great! Let's go.
ZH: 都同意？好！出发。

EN: Hey! It's you!
ZH: 嘿！是你！

EN: Oh. I uh… right. That's cool. I was just testing you. Go on in.
ZH: 哦。我呃……好吧。没事。我只是在考验你。进去吧。

EN: D-death doesn't scare me!
ZH: 死……死亡吓不倒我！

EN: You won't leave? Okay, protocol says I can kill you now.
ZH: 你不肯走？好吧，按照规定，我现在可以杀了你。

EN: What? We totally are. Can't you tell from our clothes?
ZH: 什么？我们当然是啊。你看我们的衣服还看不出来吗？

EN: You're right, I'm not. I'm Death incarnate.
ZH: 你说得对，我不是。我是死亡化身。

EN: Just pretend you didn't see us. You'll be glad you did.
ZH: 就当我们没来过。你会庆幸自己这么做的。

EN: Um… who are you?
ZH: 呃……你们是谁？

EN: No, don't answer that. You're not allowed to be here.
ZH: 不，别回答。你们不该在这里。

EN: I'm pretty sure you're not Brotherhood. So go away.
ZH: 我很确定你们不是兄弟会的人。所以请走开。

EN: Hello! You are… Vault Dwellers, I think. I can tell, of course, just by looking.
ZH: 你们好！你们是……避难所居民，我想。这我当然一眼就能看出来。

EN: It's over?! I never get informed about these things… Look, don't hurt me, I'm just a scribe!
ZH: 已经结束了？！这些事从来不通知我……听着，别伤害我，我只是个书记官！

EN: Oh. Well… here, take this for starters. Sorry about the mixup.
ZH: 哦。那……这些先拿去。误会了真是抱歉。

EN: Oh. OH NO! Where's my gun?!
ZH: 哦。哦，不！我的枪呢？！

EN: Our alliance is over. We're taking the rest of them.
ZH: 我们的同盟结束了。剩下的我们也都要拿走。

EN: Enough? We never got them.
ZH: 够？我们压根没拿到过。

EN: You gave us a knife in our back. Now we're returning it.
ZH: 你们在我们背后捅了一刀。现在该我们还回去了。

EN: I don't know what you want from us here. Didn't we already give you enough Fusion Cores?
ZH: 我不知道你们想要什么。我们不是给过你们足够的聚变核心了吗？

EN: You bastards... You'll pay for this!
ZH: 你们这群混蛋……你们会为此付出代价！

EN: I don't agree with the methods we used… but I do believe in their reasons. Die, Synth-lover!
ZH: 我不赞成我们用的手段……但我相信它们的理由。去死吧，合成人爱好者！

EN: Can't you take this seriously?! You are a heathen and a cretin! Die!
ZH: 你就不能认真点吗？！你是个异教徒和白痴！去死！

EN: You're the ones paying for your treachery.
ZH: 要为背叛付出代价的是你们。

EN: Oh, sure. Where's the bill?
ZH: 哦，当然。账单在哪儿？

EN: Ooh, a Brotherhood terminal. Let's see…
ZH: 噢，一台兄弟会终端机。看看……

EN: They're going to be so mad…
ZH: 他们会气疯的……

EN: Just think of all the paperwork they'll have to do!
ZH: 想想他们得填多少文书吧！

EN: That'll keep them busy.
ZH: 那够他们忙一阵了。

EN: <Brag in a message to all Brotherhood elite>
ZH: <给所有兄弟会精英发消息炫耀>

EN: <Erase personnel data>
ZH: <删除人员数据>

EN: <Program their turrets to shoot anything on sight>
ZH: <编程让他们的炮塔见人就打>

EN: <Shotgun>, no… <Because>, no… <Retrace>, no… <Betrays>… yes!
ZH: <霰弹枪>，不……<因为>，不……<追寻>，不……<背叛>……对了！

EN: Really? Even their password is treacherous.
ZH: 真的假的？连他们的密码都透着背叛。

EN: Well, what should we do?
ZH: 好吧，我们该怎么办？

EN: It's the Vaulties! What are they doing here? Get them!
ZH: 是那些避难所的人！他们来这干什么？抓住他们！

EN: Take them out!
ZH: 干掉他们！

EN: A Knighthood for anyone that takes their heads!
ZH: 谁砍下他们的脑袋，谁就获封骑士！

EN: We've found a Brotherhood of Steel prison for Synths and other “abominations”, where they do experiments on the inmates. Let's break them out!
ZH: 我们发现一座钢铁兄弟会的监狱，关押着合成人和其他“畸变体”，他们还在囚犯身上做实验。我们去把囚犯救出来！

EN: Abomination
ZH: 畸变体

EN: Rescue Synths
ZH: 拯救合成人

EN: Rescue some other prisoners
ZH: 拯救其他囚犯

EN: Confront the Warden
ZH: 与典狱长对质

EN: Break some “abominations” out of a Brotherhood prison.
ZH: 从兄弟会监狱中救出一些“畸变体”。

EN: Here we are at the Brotherhood prison.
ZH: 到兄弟会监狱了。

EN: I hear they're doing horrible experiments on Synths.
ZH: 听说他们在合成人身上做可怕实验。

EN: And their other prisoners too, maybe? I guess we'll find out.
ZH: 也许还有他们其他的囚犯？大概走着瞧吧。

EN: Vault Dwellers! Fascinating… Were you all born in the Vault?
ZH: 避难所居民！真有意思……你们都在避难所里出生的吗？

EN: Oh, right. Here we go…
ZH: 哦，对。又来了……

EN: They told me to! I… I shouldn't have listened. I'm sorry! Please take this!
ZH: 是他们让我这么干的！我……我真不该听他们的。对不起！请收下这个！

EN: So this is what Vault Dwellers are like. Here, it's all I have!
ZH: 原来避难所居民是这种人啊。给，这是我的全部家当了！

EN: It's ok, you can go ahead and try.
ZH: 没事，你可以尽管试试。

EN: I'm a scientist, too. I'm disgusted by your experiments.
ZH: 我也是科学家。我对你的实验感到恶心。

EN: Give me some caps and you can live.
ZH: 给我些瓶盖，你就能活命。

EN: Are you afraid of your DNA becoming mutated out in the Wasteland?
ZH: 你们害怕自己的DNA在废土上发生突变吗？

EN: Augh, I have too many questions to ask you.
ZH: 啊，我有太多问题想问你们了。

EN: And now we're enemies. I should be trying to kill you. <Sigh>
ZH: 而现在我们成了敌人。我本该试着杀掉你们。<叹气>

EN: So, there really is a break-in.
ZH: 所以，真的有人闯进来了。

EN: Nope, not at all. And soon, you won't be either!
ZH: 不，一点也不。而且很快，你也活不成了！

EN: Now you're talking my language!
ZH: 这下你说到点子上了！

EN: No way. I have memories from childhood. Just like the Synths… AHH I DON'T KNOW!
ZH: 没门。我有童年记忆。就像那些合成人一样……啊！我不知道！

EN: You really think a Synth isn't alive?
ZH: 你真觉得合成人不是活的？

EN: I don't care about Synths. I'm here to mess you up.
ZH: 我不在乎合成人。我是来揍扁你的。

EN: What if YOU are a Synth?
ZH: 万一你自己就是合成人呢？

EN: What are you after? Our prisoners? What do you want this trash for?
ZH: 你们想要什么？我们的囚犯？你们要这堆垃圾干什么？

EN: They're just machines.
ZH: 它们只是机器。

EN: Who are you? Did you come to save us?
ZH: 你们是谁？是来救我们的吗？

EN: Well, thanks a bunch!
ZH: 太好了，多谢！

EN: So, you mean… they might be right? I have to go think about this!
ZH: 所以，你是说……他们可能说得对？我得好好想想这事！

EN: Not really. Unless you want this sweaty old jumpsuit!
ZH: 还真没什么能拿来感谢的。除非你想要这件汗津津的旧连体服！

EN: I don't care who you are. Just go.
ZH: 我不在乎你是谁。走吧。

EN: Synths are programmed to think they're human.
ZH: 合成人的程序设定就是自以为是人类。

EN: You're saved. Got anything to thank us with?
ZH: 你们得救了。有什么要感谢我们的吗？

EN: They keep calling me a Synth… but I have no idea what they're talking about!
ZH: 他们一直叫我合成人……可我完全不知道他们在说什么！

EN: I'm just a guy from Diamond City.
ZH: 我只是个钻石城的普通人。

EN: You again? What do you want now?
ZH: 又是你？你这次又想干嘛？

EN: Don't have to tell me twice!
ZH: 不用你说第二遍！
